messages.content: What is the largest planet in the universe?

function.name: space_star_info

message.content:
The largest planet that has been confirmed in the entire observable universe is the exoplanet **HD 100546 b**.  
It orbits the young star HD 100546 and has a radius of roughly **2.5 × the radius of Jupiter** (about 18,000 km). This makes it the biggest planet we’ve found so far, far larger than any planet in our own Solar System.
